description: This is a server-side script for a SvelteKit application, specifically handling the loading, creation, update, deletion, and toggling of recurring invoice data. It interacts with API endpoints to fetch and modify recurring invoice records, manages pagination, filters, and transforms data for frontend consumption.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads recurring invoices data with pagination, filtering, and related accounts, transforming the API response for frontend use.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new recurring invoice from form data, sending a POST request to API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing recurring invoice identified by ID, sending a PUT request with new data.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes a recurring invoice identified by ID via API DELETE request.

methods.name: actions.toggle
methods.description: Toggles the active status of a recurring invoice via API POST request.
